name: When should I consider cabinet refinishing instead of full replacement?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider cabinet refinishing instead of full replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider cabinet refinishing when your existing cabinet boxes are in good structural condition but the appearance is dated, worn, or no longer matches your aesthetic. This is a practical tradeoff that allows for significant aesthetic improvement at a lower cost and faster timeline than a full replacement. If your goal is a fresh look without major structural changes to your kitchen in cities like Berkeley or Oakland, refinishing is an excellent choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose refinishing if your cabinet boxes are structurally sound but their appearance is outdated, offering a cost-effective update over full replacement.
